main.title: SpaceX IPO Debuts at $135 at a $1.75 Trillion Valuation on June 12 — Where Could SPCX Trade in the First 90 Days?
main.body:
SpaceX's IPO priced at $135 per share on June 12, 2026, marking the largest initial public offering in history. The offering raised approximately $75 billion at a $1.75 trillion valuation.

Business segment overview:

1. Starlink (Connectivity): The profitable core, generating $11.4 billion in revenue during 2025 with an operating profit of $4.4 billion, achieving a 63% adjusted EBITDA margin. Subscriber growth accelerated from 4.5 million at 2025's start to over 10.3 million by early 2026, operating across 164 countries.

2. Space Services: Falcon 9 division achieved profitability in 2025, completing approximately 130 missions at $67-97 million per launch. SpaceX captured over 60% of the global commercial launch market.

3. AI Division (xAI): Presents the primary financial concern, generating $3.2 billion in revenue while recording a $6.4 billion operating loss in 2025. SpaceX announced the AI1 orbital data center satellite in June 2026, targeting 150 kW peak compute capacity per unit. Gigasat factory in Bastrop, Texas (1,000+ acres) will produce AI satellites with production targeted for late 2027.

Trading structure: Only 4% initial float, with MSCI inclusion starting June 13 creating structural buying pressure. IPO was oversubscribed 3.5-4x, with total investor demand exceeding $250 billion.

Scenario projections:
- Bull: $185 (Week 1), $165 (Month 1), $200 (90 days) — driven by Starlink revenue acceleration and xAI losses narrowing
- Base: $155 (Week 1), $148 (Month 1), $160 (90 days) — steady Starlink growth, xAI losses persist
- Bear: $140 (Week 1), $130 (Month 1), $120 (90 days) — Starlink subscriber churn or regulatory setback

Retail investor access: SpaceX reserved up to 30% of shares for retail investors — far above the typical 5-10% allocation. Fidelity lowered its minimum account requirement to $2,000 specifically for this offering.

AI orbital compute strategy: The AI1 satellite functions as a solar-powered compute rack in low Earth orbit, avoiding terrestrial power and land constraints. Anthropic is paying $1.25 billion/month and Google $920 million/month for orbital compute capacity.

Author: Arslan Ali, TradingKey. Published June 11, 2026 6:00 PM = June 12, 2026 03:00 KST.

main.title: AWS Tunes Up Graviton5 For Agentic AI, Boosts Bang For The Buck Bigtime
main.body:
AWS has made Amazon EC2 M9g and M9gd instances powered by Graviton5 generally available as of June 10, 2026. The Graviton5 processor represents a major architectural shift from previous generations, purpose-built for the demands of agentic AI workloads.

The Graviton5 chip is built on TSMC's 3-nanometer manufacturing process and features a chiplet architecture rather than a monolithic design. It comprises four CPU blocks, each with 48 V3 cores, connected via die-to-die interconnects operating at 420 GB/sec, yielding 192 total cores. The chip includes 12 DDR5 memory controllers running at 8.8 GHz and eight PCI-Express 6.0 controllers with CXL 3.0 support. Power consumption is approximately 650 watts per socket.

Performance gains are substantial: M9g instances deliver between 31.9% and 33.6% better bang for the buck than the most equivalent R8g instances. Memory bandwidth is prioritized over raw capacity to support databases and agentic AI workloads requiring low latency.

Meta has announced an agreement with AWS to bring tens of millions of AWS Graviton cores into Meta's compute portfolio, making Meta one of the largest Graviton customers in the world. The rise of agentic AI is creating massive demand for CPU-intensive workloads — real-time reasoning, code generation, search, and orchestrating multi-step tasks, all of which Graviton5 is purpose-built for.

Other early Graviton5 customers include Uber and Snowflake, deploying the chips for their respective agentic workloads.

The Graviton5 chiplet design consists of four CPU blocks, each with 48 V3 cores running at up to 3.9 GHz, plus a fifth block handling I/O functions including PCIe 6.0 with CXL 3.0 and DDR5-8800 memory. This architecture enables 5x larger L3 cache per core versus Graviton4, 33% lower inter-core latency, and 15% greater network bandwidth.

AWS Nitro Cards handle security functions by offloading networking and virtualization to dedicated hardware, maintaining the principle that customer workloads are isolated from provider infrastructure.

Author: Timothy Prickett Morgan, Co-Editor and Co-Founder of The Next Platform. Article published June 11 at 22:42 UTC = June 12, 07:42 KST.
main.keep_reason: Hyperscaler in-house silicon launch — Graviton5 on TSMC 3nm with chiplet design, PCIe 6.0 + CXL 3.0, Nitro DPU offload, and Meta committing to tens of millions of cores; core MangoBoost adjacent territory.
main.select_reason: MangoBoost 직원 주목도 최상위 — Nitro DPU 오프로드 + PCIe 6.0 + CXL 3.0 + chiplet 192코어 구조 + Meta tens-of-millions 코어 약정까지, DPU/SmartNIC 인접 영역에서의 hyperscaler 자체 실리콘 GA. 신호 강도 명확.

main.title: Marvell Just Ripped 57% in a Month. Will the June 22 S&P 500 Listing Be a Sell-the-News Event?
main.body:
Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) has surged 57% over the past month ahead of its June 22 S&P 500 debut, raising the question of whether the index inclusion will prove to be a sell-the-news event. The stock gained an additional 8% on June 11, trading around $273 per share, representing a 210% year-to-date gain.

Key catalysts behind the surge:
- Strong Q1 FY2027 results: 28% year-over-year revenue growth to $2.4 billion, with CEO citing 'exceptional AI-related bookings' across custom processors and networking products
- NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang called Marvell the 'next trillion-dollar company,' triggering a 24% single-day jump after his Computex keynote on June 2
- Analyst price targets raised significantly: Citi raised to $215, Stifel to $210
- S&P 500 inclusion announcement on June 5 (effective June 22)
- NVIDIA's $2 billion strategic equity investment in Marvell (March 2026)
- NVLink Fusion partnership enabling Marvell to supply custom XPUs and scale-up networking for NVIDIA's AI infrastructure

Historical context: Analysis of 1,926 S&P 500 additions since 1957 reveals nearly 60% underperform the index after one year, with median additions trailing the index by approximately 8%.

Marvell's AI product portfolio includes: Teralynx T100 (102.4 Tbps AI data center switch with 25% lower power than competitors, sampling Q2 2026), custom XPUs for hyperscalers, NVLink Fusion-compatible networking, and OCTEON DPU/SmartNIC products.

The company's Teralynx T100 switch chip features the industry's lowest latency for AI training and inference workloads. Matt Murphy reaffirmed Q2 FY2027 guidance alongside the CFO transition announcement.

CFO transition: Dan Durn appointed as new CFO effective June 15, 2026, replacing Willem Meintjes. Durn joins from Adobe Inc., where he served as CFO from October 2021.

Published June 11, 2026 2:38 PM EDT = June 12, 2026 03:38 KST.

Author: David Moadel, 247 Wall St.

main.title: U.S. Rallies on Hopes for U.S.-Iran Deal... Korea Expected to Attempt KOSPI 8,000 Breakthrough
main.body:
The Korean stock market was anticipated to reach the 8,000-point threshold on the KOSPI on June 12, propelled by favorable external conditions. These included an impending ceasefire agreement between the U.S. and Iran, easing inflation worries from May data, and robust performance in U.S. semiconductor stocks.

The KOSPI 200 overnight futures increased 7.58%, indicating an upward opening trend. Sector rotation was expected to persist throughout trading. Market analysts recommended portfolio strategies focused on leading stocks demonstrating strong earnings momentum, given ongoing market volatility.

During the correction phase starting June 5 through the previous session, the KOSPI declined approximately 4.9%, while semiconductors fell roughly 4.5%, moving in alignment with the broader market. Additional sectors benefiting from foreign demand — including retail distribution, cosmetics, and hotels — posted positive returns. Technology hardware and AI value chain stocks similarly showed strength.

Experts noted that concentration on semiconductor stocks was easing, suggesting opportunities in underperforming sectors like securities and banking through barbell investment strategies.

President Trump canceled an airstrike against Iran and signaled that a ceasefire agreement was in its final stages, prompting sharp declines in oil prices. Brent crude fell 2.92% to $90.38 per barrel, while WTI crude dropped 2.58% to $87.71 per barrel.

The New York Stock Exchange surged on June 11: the Dow Jones climbed 1.86% to 50,848.75 points, the S&P 500 rose 1.75% to 7,394.30, and the Nasdaq gained 2.54% to 25,809.66. Semiconductor stocks led the rally, with Micron up 11.7%, Intel up 9.3%, and Nvidia up 2.2%.

Background: South Korea's semiconductor exports surged 205.8% year-on-year to $11.068 billion in the first ten days of June 2026, driving total exports up 85.9% to a record $28.6 billion. SK Hynix has risen approximately 240% year-to-date, Samsung Electronics approximately 191%, reflecting the AI chip demand supercycle powered by HBM memory for AI data centers. Combined Q2 2026 operating profit for Samsung and SK Hynix is expected to exceed 150 trillion won.

main.title: What Rising AI Model Prices and Semiconductor Cycles Mean for Investors
main.body:
A pivotal transition is underway in the artificial intelligence sector as the 'land grab' era ends and unit economics become critical for evaluating AI and semiconductor investments.

The article highlights that AI is shifting from rapid, inexpensive expansion toward a mature phase where pricing power, operational expenses, and cash flow generation matter substantially.

Key dynamics:
1. AI pricing pressure: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 pricing at $10/$50 per million input/output tokens (double Opus 4.8) signals that frontier model providers are beginning to charge premium prices as capabilities improve.
2. Semiconductor cycles: The chip industry's historically cyclical nature — boom-and-bust patterns — is complicated by AI's structural demand, but the Broadcom guidance miss in June suggests not all growth paths are smooth.
3. Investor considerations: Companies investing in semiconductors and AI infrastructure must carefully evaluate whether mounting computing expenses can be justified by revenue generation.
4. The Broadcom effect: Q3 AI chip sales guidance of $16 billion fell short of $17.2 billion analyst estimate, triggering sector-wide selloff (SOXX -10.4%, Broadcom -14%, ARM -12.8%, AMD -10.9% on June 5).

The Broadcom guidance miss catalyzed over $1.3 trillion in semiconductor market cap erasure in a single trading session, demonstrating that AI infrastructure economics matter more in 2026 than in prior years. Companies now need to show ROI on massive capex commitments.

Broadcom Q2 FY2026 context: AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8 billion (+143% YoY) beat expectations, but Q3 AI guidance of $16 billion disappointed versus the $17.2 billion estimate. This dynamic — strong absolute growth but guidance miss — is driving a market re-rating of AI infrastructure valuations.

Strategic implications: The transition from training to inference-dominated AI computing is shifting demand toward lower-power, cost-efficient chips. Companies with diverse revenue streams and proven unit economics (like Marvell with its Teralynx T100 and OCTEON DPU) may be better positioned than pure-play GPU vendors.

Published June 11, 2026 1:45 PM EST = June 12, 2026 03:45 KST.

main.title: 우주 데이터센터 본격화… 머스크의 꿈은 현실이 되나?
main.body:
스페이스X가 'AI1' 위성을 최초 공개하며 우주 데이터센터 구축이 본격화되고 있다. 일론 머스크는 AI1 위성에 대해 '우주에 있는 컴퓨팅 랙'이라고 표현했다. AI1 위성은 70미터 날개 폭을 지닌 대형 위성으로, 150kW 피크/120kW 지속 컴퓨팅 용량을 목표로 한다. 위성은 태양광 어레이(250W/m²)와 배열 가능한 액체 라디에이터 열 관리 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

머스크는 이 위성이 스타링크 위성보다 훨씬 단순한 구조라고 강조했다. 스페이스X는 텍사스 주 배스트롭에 1,000에이커 이상 규모의 '기가샛(Gigasat)' 공장을 신설해 AI 위성을 생산할 계획이며, 2027년 말부터 가동을 시작할 예정이다.

스페이스X는 2027년 초 프로토타입 AI1 위성 2기를 발사한 후 상업용 별자리를 구성할 계획이다. 궁극적으로는 최대 100만 기의 위성으로 이루어진 메가별자리를 추진한다는 계획도 담겨 있다.

우주 데이터센터 개념은 지상 전력망의 한계와 데이터센터 용량 부족을 해결하는 방안으로 제시되고 있다. 앤트로픽은 xAI 데이터센터 공간 임차 비용으로 스페이스X에 월 약 12.5억 달러를 지불하고 있으며, 구글도 월 약 9.2억 달러의 AI 컴퓨팅 계약을 체결했다고 보도된 바 있다.

그러나 업계 전문가들은 경제성 측면의 우려를 제기한다. 궤도에서 서버 하드웨어를 발사·배치·유지하는 비용이 텍사스에 서버를 설치하는 것보다 훨씬 높다는 지적이다. 스페이스X의 IPO 일정(6월 12일 나스닥 상장)과 맞물려 투자자용 내러티브가 아니냐는 의문도 있다.

스페이스X는 이번 IPO에서 주당 135달러에 5억 5,556만 주를 매각, 약 750억 달러를 조달하고 1조 7,500억 달러의 기업가치를 목표로 하고 있다.
